mapper.insert: insert into ai_agent_run (id, tenant_id, conversation_id, request_id, model_connection_id, run_status, started_time, lease_until) values (#{e.id}, #{e.tenantId}, #{e.conversationId}, #{e.requestId}, #{e.modelConnectionId}, #{e.runStatus}, current_timestamp, #{e.leaseUntil})
mapper.select: select * from ai_agent_run where conversation_id = #{conversationId} and run_status in ('running', 'cancel_requested')
mapper.update: update ai_agent_run set run_status = 'cancel_requested', cancel_requested_time = current_timestamp where id = #{id} and run_status = 'running'
mapper.select: update ai_agent_run set run_status = case when run_status = 'cancel_requested' then 'cancelled' else #{e.runStatus} end, finished_time = current_timestamp, input_tokens = #{e.inputTokens}, output_tokens = #{e.outputTokens}, error_code = case when run_status = 'cancel_requested' then null else #{e.errorCode} end, error_message = case when run_status = 'cancel_requested' then null else #{e.errorMessage} end where id = #{e.id} and run_status in ('running', 'cancel_requested') returning run_status
select * from ai_agent_run where run_status in ('running', 'cancel_requested') and lease_until < current_timestamp order by lease_until, id limit 100 for update skip locked
